summary: Eason Technology Ltd (a Cayman exempted company) filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, reporting the closing of a private placement first disclosed on May 26, 2026. Under a securities purchase agreement with unnamed investors, the company sold 2 million units, each unit comprising 60,000 Class A ordinary shares and one warrant for 60,000 shares, for gross proceeds of $2 million (price per unit $1.00, equal to ~$0.0000167 per share). The offering closed on June 8, 2026, upon satisfaction of closing conditions; no board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation dynamics (premium, regulatory clock, risk arbitrage) are involved. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
